name: upscaler_torture_tsr_high
title: Upscaler Torture, TSR High at 2160p output and 0.5 scale (GT-4 T1)

lines.name: TSR High, 2160p output at 0.5 (T1)
lines.reason: UE renders the 3840x2160 output in a DPI-aware launch: the runner gives the editor the HighDpiAware compatibility layer for that launch only, and the machine's desktop keeps its 125 % scaling (lead decision 2026-11-16). Without it, 3840x2160 requests recorded 3072x1728 (fullscreen) and 2560x1440 (windowed). UE's internal resolution comes from the GPU profiler: the set runs ProfileGPU once at start-up, inside the warm-up rows, and Epic's TSR page says the TemporalSuperResolution draw event includes the rendering and display resolutions; the report reads them from the log and refuses a run that rendered at another size than the GodotNext runs' internal 1920x1080, or (when judged) one that logged none. A DPI-aware fullscreen launch on the RTX 4080 SUPER (2026-11-16) recorded 3840x2160 and logged the TSR draw event at 1920x1080 -> 3840x2160.
